meaning: An axiom-free conditional connection: inductive (finite-source) grounding of every being's power, together with uncaused sources and linear per se series, yields STMT-NO-INFINITE-PER-SE-EFFICIENT-CAUSE-SERIES's formal reading. It locates what the grounding route to the regress premise still needs; it does not discharge that premise, since none of the three antecedents is sourced or proved of real per se causes (DISAMB-CAUSAL-POWER-GROUNDING keeps inductive grounding an open choice).
